title: Three-stop practice walk
description: Synthetic publication example. Not a real city walk; stay where you are.

stops.title: A word

stops.title: A shape

stops.title: A final word

stops.clue: Practice card: TAKE NOTICE. What is the second word?
stops.reveal: You completed all three practice stops.
